subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should raw token, cost, and quota usage become part of `session_status.details`, move into a separate agent-facing usage tool, or remain only on Gateway/operator usage surfaces?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the public API boundary affects privacy, session visibility, source/freshness metadata, and long-term compatibility for agent tools.

options.title: Add structured `session_status.details.usage`
options.body: Extend the existing status tool with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the current rendered card.

options.title: Create a separate agent usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower usage query tool that reuses Gateway/transcript parsers under the same visibility guard.

options.title: Keep usage operator-only for now
options.body: Leave raw usage on Gateway/operator surfaces until a broader usage-ledger or freshness-metadata design lands.

recommendation.title: Add structured `session_status.details.usage`
recommendation.body: Extend the existing status tool with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the current rendered card.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `session_status` and has the strongest recent review context for the exact structured-usage gap.
